styleParameterGrammar.scale: model-space furniture plan symbol, nominal overall footprint 1200mm x 600mm, drawn as preview-only parametric intent; lineweights expressed as CAD style targets, not verified CAD attributes

candidateTradeoffs.tradeoff: 单一候选足够：用户要求设计一个茶几符号并做 preview-only CAD 校验，没有明确要求两套、A/B/C、候选比较或用户选择。该方案优先可读性和家具平面符号识别度，避免施工详图复杂度。参数建议：外轮廓为圆角矩形桌面，长宽比 2:1，目标尺寸 1200x600；圆角半径 60；内嵌桌面边线偏移 45；中心短向装饰/结构线 1 条，距中心线对称留白；可选四角脚位以 45x45 小方块或短线表示，距外轮廓内缩 80。文字层级：不强制放置文字，若下游需要标签，用 120 高文字、字距 1.0、行距 1.2，置于符号下方 150，内容建议 CT 或 茶几。图层策略：新建或目标预览层使用 FURN_PREVIEW 或 SYMBOL_FURN_PREVIEW；外轮廓颜色 7/白黑随底色，连续线型，线宽 0.25；内嵌线颜色 8/灰，连续线型，线宽 0.13；脚位颜色 7，线宽 0.18；标签颜色 2 或 ByLayer，线宽 0.13。对象类型：LWPOLYLINE/ARC 或等价圆角矩形、多段线内嵌轮廓、LINE 装饰线、TEXT/MTEXT 可选。密度：低到中，约 6-10 个可见对象，适合 preview-only 快速校验。取舍：牺牲真实构造细节，换取在家具平面图中一眼识别为茶几并便于 dry-run/readback 检查 bbox、layer 和 handles。

learningCandidate.trigger: style_generation_review completed with single candidate under preview-only CAD boundary
learningCandidate.correctPattern: Generate one structured, downstream-consumable style candidate when the user requests one object design without explicit multi-candidate comparison.

statePatch.blockedReason: CAD execution is not authorized in this style generation review; dispatch plan is blocked for request_kind='draw' because cad_policy.allow_cad=false.
statePatch.nextSafeAction: Pass the selected style candidate to pipeline_visual_intent or pipeline_intent as preview-only design intent, then continue through validate, dry-run, preview, readback, and visual acceptance gates.

No user choice is required because the request did not explicitly ask for multiple alternatives or comparison.
Downstream agents still need CAD_PLAN generation, validation, dry-run, preview, readback, and visual acceptance before delivery claims.
